facts: Private fields are final List<Palette> palettes, final List<StructureEntityInfo> entityInfoList and mutable Vec3i size. A bounded observer can inspect these lists before serializing an entire template.

Palette.blocks() returns its live underlying list. StructureBlockInfo is a public record(BlockPos pos,BlockState state,nullable CompoundTag nbt) with public record accessors; EntityInfo exposes final Vec3 pos,BlockPos blockPos,CompoundTag nbt fields.

placeInWorld returns false for no palettes, for no selected blocks/entities, or any size component below1. It returns true after attempting accepted/rejected writes and entities; the result does not require any setBlock to succeed.
Primary requested block setBlock is separate from a preceding optional barrier write and later neighbor-shape update. The primary boolean governs accepted block bookkeeping.
Native processing, fluids, block-entity NBT and neighbor updates may alter final state after primary setBlock. Accepted writes do not imply a complete/unchanged finished structure.
save(CompoundTag) walks all palettes/blocks/entities. A bound checked only after save does not bound serialization work.
scope: API facts and source locations only; full decompiled source remains outside repository in the local SDK artifact.
